value.rationale: Proves rational generalized tracial rank one and Elliott-classifiability for crossed products of TR<=1 UCT algebras by compact weak-tracial-Rokhlin-with-comparison actions, completing the target classification consequence via (b) while honestly leaving exact TR1 open.
